label: s1_sub_018_woman_01
text: We’re pretty much the most lovey-dovey couple\never, don’tcha think?

label: s1_sub_018_man_01
text: You bet! There’s probably not a pair on the\nplanet as perfect together as you and me.

label: s1_sub_018_woman_04
text: We’re wondering if there are any Pokémon\nthat are lovey-dovey like the two of us.\r\nIf you manage to find any, bring ’em here!

label: s1_sub_018_man_02
text: Oh, I’m sure you’ll find one—when Lechonk fly!\nAhaha!

label: s1_sub_018_woman_05
text: Did you find some lovey-dovey Pokémon that\nare always together?

label: s1_sub_018_man_03
text: See? There’s no way a Pokémon could out-lovey\nOR out-dovey us! Ahaha!

label: s1_sub_018_man_04
text: This Pokémon...\c\nNope—it’s not even dovey, let alone lovey!\nAhaha!

label: s1_sub_018_man_05
text: Wh-what’s this?! A Tandemaus?!\c\nThey’re lovey-dovey, they come in pairs, and\nthey’re always together?!

label: s1_sub_018_man_06
text: Wh-what’s this? A Maushold?!\c\nSo lovey-dovey that they ended up with a\nprecious little bundle of joy?!

label: s1_sub_018_man_07
text: Wh-what’s this? A Maushold?!\c\nSo lovey-dovey that they have two li’l ones?!\nA happy li’l family?!

label: s1_sub_018_woman_06
text: So there ARE Pokémon out there that are head\nover heels for each other like we are!

label: s1_sub_018_woman_07
text: Thank you for showing us that Pokémon! How\nabout we teach you a special pose in return?

label: s1_sub_018_system_01
text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Heart (Right) emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] and the\n[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Heart (Left) emote [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from the lovey-dovey couple!

label: s1_sub_018_woman_npc
text: You should use that heart pose we taught you\ntogether with someone special!

label: s1_sub_018_man_npc
text: Pokémon and humans... We both have so much\nlove to share, don’t we?
